Original User Story: I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As an individual, I want to create a semi-structured personal page that effectively showcases my background and interests so that visitors can gain a comprehensive understanding of who I am.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include at least 5 distinct sections detailing my professional experience, education, skills, hobbies, and personal achievements.
- Ensure that each section contains a minimum of 100 words to provide sufficient detail.
- Allow for easy navigation between sections to enhance user experience.

Test Outline:
- Review the personal page to confirm that all required sections are present and contain the specified word count.
- Test the navigation functionality to ensure users can seamlessly move between different sections without any issues.

Original User Story: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As an aspiring Scrum professional, I want to complete the application process for the Certified Scrum Practitioner designation so that I can officially validate my skills and enhance my career opportunities in agile project management.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully submit the application form with all required information and documentation.
- Receive confirmation of application submission within 24 hours.
- Achieve certification within 6 weeks of application approval, contingent upon meeting all prerequisites.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form is filled out correctly and submitted without errors.
- Check for an email confirmation of the application submission within the specified timeframe.
- Track the certification process to ensure it is completed within the 6-week target after approval.

Original User Story: As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a Practitioner, I want to enhance my profile page with comprehensive details about my professional background so that I can effectively showcase my experience and attract potential clients or collaborators.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include fields for at least 5 key areas of expertise or skills relevant to my profession.
- Allow the addition of a minimum of 3 past projects or case studies that highlight my experience.
- Enable the upload of a professional profile picture and a resume to provide a complete overview of my qualifications.

Test Outline:
- Review the profile page to ensure all specified fields for expertise, projects, and uploads are present and functional.
- Verify that users can successfully input and save their information without errors.
- Check that the profile displays the added details correctly and is visually appealing to visitors.

Original User Story: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to complete an application process to obtain certification as a Scrum Trainer, so that I can effectively teach Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) courses and empower others to achieve their certifications.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully submit the application form with all required information and documentation.
- Receive confirmation of application submission within 24 hours.
- Achieve a response regarding application approval or feedback within 14 business days.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form can be filled out and submitted without errors.
- Check for an automated confirmation email sent to the applicant within the specified timeframe.
- Monitor the timeline for feedback on the application to ensure it aligns with the 14 business day target.

Original User Story: As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a Trainer, I want to enhance my profile page with comprehensive details about my background and expertise so that potential clients can make informed decisions about my suitability as their trainer.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include a minimum of 200 words detailing my qualifications, experience, and training philosophy.
- Add at least 3 testimonials from previous clients to showcase my effectiveness and impact.
- Ensure that my profile page is visually appealing and easy to navigate, with all information accessible within 3 clicks.

Test Outline:
- Review the profile page to confirm that the additional details meet the word count and content requirements.
- Check for the presence of at least 3 client testimonials and assess their relevance and quality.
- Navigate through the profile page to ensure that all information is easily accessible and user-friendly.

Original User Story: As the site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As the site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that the articles are visually engaging and enhance the reader's experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Implement a user-friendly interface that allows for at least 10 customizable formatting options (e.g., font size, color schemes, spacing).
- Ensure that all articles maintain a consistent visual style that adheres to brand guidelines across 100% of published content.
- Allow for real-time previews of changes made to the article layout before final publication.

Test Outline:
- Test the formatting interface to confirm that all 10 customization options are functional and accessible.
- Review a sample of published articles to ensure they align with the established visual style guidelines.
- Validate that changes made in the formatting interface are accurately reflected in the real-time preview.

Original User Story: As a site editor, I want to create the content of the What Is Scrum section, so that it's there for visitors.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to develop comprehensive content for the "What Is Scrum" section so that visitors can easily understand the Scrum framework and its benefits, enhancing their overall experience on the site.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The content must clearly define Scrum, including its roles, events, and artifacts, in no less than 500 words.
- Ensure that at least 3 real-world examples of Scrum implementation are included to illustrate its practical application.
- The section should be optimized for SEO, achieving a keyword density of 1-2% for relevant terms related to Scrum.

Test Outline:
- Review the content to confirm it meets the minimum word count and includes the required definitions and examples.
- Use an SEO tool to analyze the keyword density and ensure it aligns with the specified criteria.
